# 5. Statistical testing (pseudobulk)

**Module 05b — Statistical testing, pseudobulk (optional).** Differential abundance, clustering, and colocalization tests at the sample level. Each cell type is aggregated to one mean per `sample_alias`, then limma tests those sample means. Skip this module if you do not need formal comparisons, or if you do not have biological replicates. Run the first chunk below after module `02` has finished.

This notebook is the replicate-aware alternative to `modules/05a_statistical_testing_cell_level.qmd`. Cell-level Wilcoxon tests treat every cell as independent, which overstates significance when many cells come from the same sample. Limma here uses the sample as the unit of replication. It needs **≥2 `sample_alias` values per condition**. If that is not true, each test below warns and skips the fit so rendering still finishes. Outputs go under `{modality}/pseudobulk/`. Module 07 reads them when `stats_method` is `"pseudobulk"`.

```{r}
#| label: module05b_setup

library(here)
here::i_am("modules/05b_statistical_testing_pseudobulk.qmd")

source(here::here("modules", "common_setup.R"))

if (!exists("pg_data", inherits = TRUE)) {
  pg_data <- load_checkpoint("annotated_seurat_object.rds")
}
if (!exists("markers_to_test", inherits = TRUE)) {
  markers_to_test <- load_checkpoint("markers_to_test.rds")
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(limma))
```

## 5.0. Set Up Statistical Testing

> **Decision checkpoint** (statistical contrasts and plot cutoffs)  
> Set `contrast_column` and `reference_condition` (a value in that column). All `{target}_vs_{reference}` outputs in this notebook use this baseline. Adjust the significance and effect-size cutoffs used for summary plots. Result tables (`.rds` and `.csv`) are saved in full regardless of plot cutoffs.  
> Optionally set `pseudobulk_covariate_cols` to metadata columns (for example `c("donor", "batch")`) to include in the limma model. Leave `NULL` for a condition-only model. Do not add the contrast column itself.

By default, in this analysis we compare all conditions to a reference condition, which is typically the "resting" or "control" condition. Sample means in each other condition are compared with sample means in the reference.

```{r}
#| label: module05b_set_reference

# Column in the Seurat object defining the groups to compare.
contrast_column <- "condition"

# Baseline / control condition. Must match a value in contrast_column.
# All tests compare each other condition against this one (target − reference).
# Output folders are named {target}_vs_{reference}.
reference_condition <- "resting"

# Summary-plot cutoffs. Volcano labels are the top n features by adjusted
# significance. These do not filter the saved result tables.
dabund_plot_p_adj_threshold <- 0.05
dabund_heatmap_effect_threshold <- 0.5
dabund_volcano_top_n <- 5

dclust_plot_p_adj_threshold <- 0.05
dclust_heatmap_effect_threshold <- 0.5
dclust_volcano_top_n <- 5

# Same effect-heatmap rule as abundance and clustering.
dcoloc_plot_p_adj_threshold <- 0.001
dcoloc_heatmap_effect_threshold <- 0.5
dcoloc_volcano_top_n <- 5

if (!contrast_column %in% colnames(pg_data[[]])) {
  stop(
    "Contrast column '", contrast_column, "' is not present in the Seurat object. ",
    "Available columns: ", paste(colnames(pg_data[[]]), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

available_conditions <- unique(as.character(pg_data[[]][[contrast_column]]))
if (
  length(reference_condition) != 1L ||
    is.na(reference_condition) ||
    !reference_condition %in% available_conditions
) {
  stop(
    "The reference condition '", reference_condition, "' is not present in ",
    contrast_column, ". Available values: ",
    paste(available_conditions, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

target_conditions_preview <- setdiff(available_conditions, reference_condition)
if (length(target_conditions_preview) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No target conditions found in ", contrast_column,
    " after excluding reference_condition ('", reference_condition, "')."
  )
}

message(
  "Contrast column: ", contrast_column, "\n",
  "Reference condition: ", reference_condition, "\n",
  "Comparisons to run: ",
  paste(paste0(target_conditions_preview, "_vs_", reference_condition), collapse = ", ")
)

# Optional batch / donor columns from metadata.csv to include in limma models,
# e.g. c("donor", "batch"). Leave as NULL for none. Do not add the contrast
# column here.
pseudobulk_covariate_cols <- NULL
```

Aggregation, plotting, and saving are done inline in each section below, mirroring `05a_statistical_testing_cell_level.qmd`. Limma itself has no equivalent in 05a, so the fitting logic is written directly into each of the three analysis chunks (§5.1–§5.3).

### Sample-level Aggregation

Limma is fit on these tables, not on single cells. Each row is one sample × cell type × marker (or marker pair). The same tables feed the sample heatmaps, so the plot shows the values that were tested.

#### Abundance Summary

```{r}
#| label: module05b_aggregate_abundance
#| include: false

# Mean CLR per sample × cell type × marker. This is the expression matrix
# limma sees in §5.1, and the values drawn in the sample heatmaps.
summary_abundance_data <-
  names(markers_to_test) |>
  map(function(cell_type) {
    dat <- FetchData(
      subset(pg_data, cell_annotation == cell_type),
      vars = c(
        "sample_alias",
        contrast_column,
        as.character(unname(markers_to_test[[cell_type]]))
      ),
      layer = "data"
    )
    marker_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dat), c("sample_alias", contrast_column))
    dat |>
      pivot_longer(all_of(marker_cols), names_to = "marker", values_to = "clr") |>
      group_by(.data$sample_alias, .data[[contrast_column]], .data$marker) |>
      summarise(mean_clr = mean(clr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      mutate(group = cell_type)
  }) |>
  bind_rows()

# abundance_dir <- here::here("results", "05_statistical_testing", "abundance", "pseudobulk")
# dir.create(abundance_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
# write_rds(summary_abundance_data, file.path(abundance_dir, "summary_abundance_data.rds"))
# write_csv(summary_abundance_data, file.path(abundance_dir, "summary_abundance_data.csv"))
```

#### Proximity Summary

`FilterProximityScores()` drops pairs below an isotype-derived background, then `SummarizeProximityScores()` takes the mean `log2_ratio` per `sample_alias` × cell type. Clustering (§5.2) uses the self-pairs (`marker_1 == marker_2`); colocalization (§5.3) uses the off-diagonal pairs. Both tests therefore see the same sample means.

```{r}
#| label: module05b_aggregate_proximity

# Mean log2_ratio per sample_alias × cell type × pair. The isotype cutoff is
# computed once on the full object: median isotype fraction + 2 MAD (minimum 0.001).
bg <- if ("isotype_fraction" %in% colnames(pg_data[[]])) {
  max(median(pg_data$isotype_fraction, na.rm = TRUE) + 2 * mad(pg_data$isotype_fraction, na.rm = TRUE), 0.001)
} else {
  0.001
}
summary_proximity_data <- names(markers_to_test) |>
  map(function(cell_type) {
    obj <- subset(pg_data, cell_annotation == cell_type)
    # Pull the markers out first. filter() is evaluated in DuckDB, and
    # markers_to_test[[cell_type]] is a list, which SQL cannot interpolate.
    markers_vec <- markers_to_test[[cell_type]]
    ProximityScores(obj, lazy = TRUE, meta_data_columns = "sample_alias", add_marker_proportions = TRUE) |>
      filter(marker_1 %in% markers_vec, marker_2 %in% markers_vec) |>
      FilterProximityScores(background_threshold_pct = bg) |>
      SummarizeProximityScores(
        proximity_metric = "log2_ratio", group_vars = "sample_alias",
        summary_stat = "mean", include_missing_obs = TRUE
      ) |>
      mutate(feature = paste(marker_1, marker_2, sep = "_"), group = cell_type)
  }) |>
  bind_rows()

#proximity_dir <- here::here("results", "05_statistical_testing", "proximity", "pseudobulk")
#dir.create(proximity_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
#write_rds(summary_proximity_data, file.path(proximity_dir, "summary_proximity_data.rds"))
#write_csv(summary_proximity_data, file.path(proximity_dir, "summary_proximity_data.csv"))
```

## 5.1. Differential abundance analysis

Limma is fit on `summary_abundance_data` (mean CLR per `sample_alias` × cell type × marker). The model formula uses `contrast_column`, plus any columns in `pseudobulk_covariate_cols`. The coefficient for each non-reference condition is the difference in mean CLR. Results are written as `differential_abundance_analysis.rds` under `abundance/pseudobulk/`. In module 07, set `stats_method` to `"pseudobulk"` to use these tables (the default `"cell_level"` reads module 05a).

```{r}
#| label: module05b_abundance

# Limma cannot estimate a condition effect from a single sample, so skip the
# fit (without aborting the render) when a condition has fewer than two samples.
n_per_condition <- pg_data[[]] |>
  distinct(.data$sample_alias, .data[[contrast_column]]) |>
  count(.data[[contrast_column]]) |>
  pull(n)
if (length(n_per_condition) == 0 || any(n_per_condition < 2)) {
  warning("Skipping pseudobulk abundance: need ≥2 sample_alias per condition.", call. = FALSE)
} else {
  # Covariates besides the contrast column itself and sample_alias.
  covariate_cols <- setdiff(as.character(pseudobulk_covariate_cols), c(contrast_column, "sample_alias"))

  differential_abundance_analysis_pseudobulk <-
    names(markers_to_test) |>
    map(function(cell_type) {
      tryCatch(
        {
          agg <- summary_abundance_data |> filter(group == cell_type)

          # One row per sample. Sourced from pg_data (not agg), so this also
          # works below for proximity tables that drop the contrast column.
          sample_info <- pg_data[[]] |>
            as_tibble() |>
            transmute(
              sample_alias = as.character(.data$sample_alias),
              !!contrast_column := as.character(.data[[contrast_column]])
            ) |>
            distinct() |>
            filter(.data$sample_alias %in% unique(as.character(agg$sample_alias)))
          if (length(covariate_cols) > 0) {
            sample_info <- sample_info |>
              left_join(
                metadata |>
                  transmute(sample_alias = as.character(.data$sample_alias), across(all_of(covariate_cols))) |>
                  distinct(sample_alias, .keep_all = TRUE),
                by = "sample_alias"
              ) |>
              drop_na(all_of(covariate_cols))
          }
          sample_info <- sample_info |>
            mutate(!!contrast_column := droplevels(relevel(factor(.data[[contrast_column]]), ref = reference_condition))) |>
            arrange(.data$sample_alias)

          # One column of expr_mat is one sample, so residual df come from
          # samples, not cells.
          expr_mat <- agg |>
            mutate(sample_alias = as.character(sample_alias)) |>
            filter(.data$sample_alias %in% sample_info$sample_alias) |>
            select(marker, sample_alias, mean_clr) |>
            pivot_wider(names_from = sample_alias, values_from = mean_clr, values_fn = mean) |>
            column_to_rownames("marker") |>
            as.matrix()
          expr_mat <- expr_mat[, sample_info$sample_alias, drop = FALSE]

          rhs <- if (length(covariate_cols) > 0) {
            paste("~", contrast_column, "+", paste(covariate_cols, collapse = " + "))
          } else {
            paste("~", contrast_column)
          }
          design <- model.matrix(stats::as.formula(rhs), data = sample_info)
          fit <- eBayes(lmFit(expr_mat, design), trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

          # adj.P.Val is BH within this fit (one cell type, one contrast), so
          # this is the cell type × contrast FDR.
          map_dfr(setdiff(levels(sample_info[[contrast_column]]), reference_condition), function(target) {
            topTable(fit, coef = paste0(contrast_column, target), number = Inf, sort.by = "none", adjust.method = "BH") |>
              as_tibble(rownames = "marker") |>
              transmute(
                marker,
                difference = .data$logFC,
                p = .data$P.Value,
                p_adj = .data$adj.P.Val,
                target = target,
                reference = reference_condition,
                method = "limma_pseudobulk"
              )
          }) |>
            mutate(group = cell_type)
        },
        error = function(e) {
          message(paste("Pseudobulk abundance error for", cell_type, ":", e$message))
          NULL
        }
      )
    }) |>
    bind_rows()

  abundance_dir <- here::here("results", "05_statistical_testing", "abundance", "pseudobulk")
  dir.create(abundance_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write_rds(differential_abundance_analysis_pseudobulk, file.path(abundance_dir, "differential_abundance_analysis.rds"))
  write_csv(differential_abundance_analysis_pseudobulk, file.path(abundance_dir, "differential_abundance_analysis.csv"))
}
```

### 5.1.1. Summarizing plots

Here we create summarizing plots for the differential abundance analysis results, plotting only the first non-reference target (the saved tables above keep every target):

1. **Per-cell-type volcano + sample heatmap**: For each cell type, a volcano (effect size vs −log10 adjusted p-value, top `dabund_volcano_top_n` markers labeled by **adjusted significance**, not largest |effect|) and a row-z-scored heatmap of sample-mean CLR (`summary_abundance_data`) for those same labeled markers. Both are saved in the cell type's own folder.

2. **Effect-size heatmap**: Markers with `p_adj < dabund_plot_p_adj_threshold` and `|effect| > dabund_heatmap_effect_threshold` across cell types.

```{r}
#| label: module05b_abundance_plots

if (
  exists("differential_abundance_analysis_pseudobulk") &&
    nrow(differential_abundance_analysis_pseudobulk) > 0
) {
  modality <- "abundance"
  target <- setdiff(unique(differential_abundance_analysis_pseudobulk$target), reference_condition)[1]

  # results/05_statistical_testing/{modality}/pseudobulk/{target}_vs_{reference}/...
  plot_path <- function(...) {
    here::here(
      "results/05_statistical_testing", modality, "pseudobulk",
      paste0(target, "_vs_", reference_condition),
      ...
    )
  }

  plot_data <- differential_abundance_analysis_pseudobulk |>
    filter(target == !!target) |>
    mutate(neg_log10_p_adj = -log10(pmax(p_adj, min_p_value_threshold)))

  # Per cell type: volcano with its n most significant labeled markers, plus a
  # row-z-scored sample heatmap of those same markers' CLR means. Both saved
  # under the cell type's own folder within the target-vs-reference folder.
  walk(unique(plot_data$group), function(cell_type) {
    data <- filter(plot_data, group == cell_type)
    labels <- slice_max(data, order_by = neg_log10_p_adj, n = dabund_volcano_top_n, with_ties = FALSE)

    volcano <- ggplot(data, aes(difference, neg_log10_p_adj, color = difference)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.7) +
      geom_text(data = labels, aes(label = marker), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
      scale_color_gradient2() +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = paste0(cell_type, " (", target, " vs ", reference_condition, ")"), x = "Difference", y = "-log10(FDR-adjusted p-value)")
    export_plot(plot_path(cell_type, paste0("differential_", modality, "_volcano")), volcano, width = 6, height = 5)

    clr_mat <- summary_abundance_data |>
      filter(group == cell_type, marker %in% labels$marker) |>
      select(marker, sample_alias, mean_clr) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = sample_alias, values_from = mean_clr) |>
      column_to_rownames("marker") |>
      as.matrix()
    clr_mat <- t(scale(t(clr_mat[labels$marker, , drop = FALSE])))
    sample_hm <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
      clr_mat,
      color = PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
      name = "CLR z-score",
      main = paste0(cell_type, " (", target, " vs ", reference_condition, ")")
    ) |>
      as.ggplot()
    export_plot(plot_path(cell_type, "sample_heatmap"), sample_hm, width = 6, height = 5)
  })

  # Effect-size heatmap of significant markers across cell types
  heatmap_mat <- plot_data |>
    filter(p_adj < dabund_plot_p_adj_threshold, abs(difference) > dabund_heatmap_effect_threshold) |>
    select(marker, group, difference) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = difference, values_fill = 0) |>
    column_to_rownames("marker") |>
    as.matrix()
  heatmap_plot <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_mat,
    color = PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
    main = paste0(target, " vs ", reference_condition)
  ) |>
    as.ggplot()
  export_plot(plot_path("effect_size_heatmap_all_celltypes"), heatmap_plot, width = 6, height = 6)
}
```

## 5.2. Differential clustering analysis

Self-proximity (`marker_1 == marker_2`) from `summary_proximity_data`, then limma. Column `diff_median` stores the limma logFC (mean difference). Module 07 expects that column name, which is what the cell-level Wilcoxon clustering table uses for its median difference.

```{r}
#| label: module05b_clustering

# Limma cannot estimate a condition effect from a single sample, so skip the
# fit (without aborting the render) when a condition has fewer than two samples.
n_per_condition <- pg_data[[]] |>
  distinct(.data$sample_alias, .data[[contrast_column]]) |>
  count(.data[[contrast_column]]) |>
  pull(n)
if (length(n_per_condition) == 0 || any(n_per_condition < 2)) {
  warning("Skipping pseudobulk clustering: need ≥2 sample_alias per condition.", call. = FALSE)
} else {
  # Covariates besides the contrast column itself and sample_alias.
  covariate_cols <- setdiff(as.character(pseudobulk_covariate_cols), c(contrast_column, "sample_alias"))

  differential_clustering_analysis_pseudobulk <-
    (
      if (nrow(summary_proximity_data) > 0) {
        names(markers_to_test) |>
          map(function(cell_type) {
            tryCatch(
              {
                agg <- summary_proximity_data |>
                  filter(group == cell_type, marker_1 == marker_2)

                # One row per sample.
                sample_info <- pg_data[[]] |>
                  as_tibble() |>
                  transmute(
                    sample_alias = as.character(.data$sample_alias),
                    !!contrast_column := as.character(.data[[contrast_column]])
                  ) |>
                  distinct() |>
                  filter(.data$sample_alias %in% unique(as.character(agg$sample_alias)))
                if (length(covariate_cols) > 0) {
                  sample_info <- sample_info |>
                    left_join(
                      metadata |>
                        transmute(sample_alias = as.character(.data$sample_alias), across(all_of(covariate_cols))) |>
                        distinct(sample_alias, .keep_all = TRUE),
                      by = "sample_alias"
                    ) |>
                    drop_na(all_of(covariate_cols))
                }
                sample_info <- sample_info |>
                  mutate(!!contrast_column := droplevels(relevel(factor(.data[[contrast_column]]), ref = reference_condition))) |>
                  arrange(.data$sample_alias)

                # Missing sample × pair combinations become 0 (no observed
                # self-proximity), not NA, so limma can still fit them.
                expr_mat <- agg |>
                  mutate(sample_alias = as.character(sample_alias)) |>
                  filter(.data$sample_alias %in% sample_info$sample_alias) |>
                  select(feature, sample_alias, mean_log2_ratio) |>
                  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_alias, values_from = mean_log2_ratio, values_fill = 0, values_fn = mean) |>
                  column_to_rownames("feature") |>
                  as.matrix()
                expr_mat <- expr_mat[, sample_info$sample_alias, drop = FALSE]

                rhs <- if (length(covariate_cols) > 0) {
                  paste("~", contrast_column, "+", paste(covariate_cols, collapse = " + "))
                } else {
                  paste("~", contrast_column)
                }
                design <- model.matrix(stats::as.formula(rhs), data = sample_info)
                fit <- eBayes(lmFit(expr_mat, design), trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

                # adj.P.Val is BH within this fit (one cell type, one contrast).
                map_dfr(setdiff(levels(sample_info[[contrast_column]]), reference_condition), function(target) {
                  topTable(fit, coef = paste0(contrast_column, target), number = Inf, sort.by = "none", adjust.method = "BH") |>
                    as_tibble(rownames = "feature") |>
                    transmute(
                      feature,
                      diff_median = .data$logFC,
                      p = .data$P.Value,
                      p_adj = .data$adj.P.Val,
                      target = target,
                      reference = reference_condition,
                      method = "limma_pseudobulk"
                    )
                }) |>
                  left_join(distinct(agg, feature, marker_1, marker_2), by = "feature") |>
                  transmute(marker_1, marker_2, diff_median, p, p_adj, target, reference, method, group = cell_type)
              },
              error = function(e) {
                message(paste("Pseudobulk clustering error for", cell_type, ":", e$message))
                NULL
              }
            )
          }) |>
          bind_rows()
      } else {
        tibble()
      }
    )

  clustering_dir <- here::here("results", "05_statistical_testing", "clustering", "pseudobulk")
  dir.create(clustering_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write_rds(differential_clustering_analysis_pseudobulk, file.path(clustering_dir, "differential_clustering_analysis.rds"))
  write_csv(differential_clustering_analysis_pseudobulk, file.path(clustering_dir, "differential_clustering_analysis.csv"))
}
```

### 5.2.1. Summarizing plots

Here we create summarizing plots for the differential clustering analysis results, with the same layout as §5.1.1:

1. **Per-cell-type volcano + sample heatmap**: Volcano of `diff_median` vs −log10 adjusted p-value, top `dclust_volcano_top_n` markers labeled by **adjusted significance**, beside a row-z-scored heatmap of sample-mean self-proximity (`log2_ratio`, `marker_1 == marker_2` in `summary_proximity_data`). Saved in the cell type's own folder.

2. **Effect-size heatmap**: Markers with `p_adj < dclust_plot_p_adj_threshold` and `|diff_median| > dclust_heatmap_effect_threshold` across cell types.

```{r}
#| label: module05b_clustering_plots

if (
  exists("differential_clustering_analysis_pseudobulk") &&
    nrow(differential_clustering_analysis_pseudobulk) > 0
) {
  modality <- "clustering"
  target <- setdiff(unique(differential_clustering_analysis_pseudobulk$target), reference_condition)[1]

  # results/05_statistical_testing/{modality}/pseudobulk/{target}_vs_{reference}/...
  plot_path <- function(...) {
    here::here(
      "results/05_statistical_testing", modality, "pseudobulk",
      paste0(target, "_vs_", reference_condition),
      ...
    )
  }

  # Self-proximity: marker_1 is the feature (marker_1 == marker_2).
  plot_data <- differential_clustering_analysis_pseudobulk |>
    filter(target == !!target) |>
    mutate(
      marker = marker_1,
      neg_log10_p_adj = -log10(pmax(p_adj, min_p_value_threshold))
    )

  # Per cell type: volcano with its n most significant labeled markers, plus a
  # row-z-scored sample heatmap of those markers' self-proximity. Both saved
  # under the cell type's own folder within the target-vs-reference folder.
  walk(unique(plot_data$group), function(cell_type) {
    data <- filter(plot_data, group == cell_type)
    labels <- slice_max(data, order_by = neg_log10_p_adj, n = dclust_volcano_top_n, with_ties = FALSE)

    volcano <- ggplot(data, aes(diff_median, neg_log10_p_adj, color = diff_median)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.7) +
      geom_text(data = labels, aes(label = marker), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
      scale_color_gradient2() +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = paste0(cell_type, " (", target, " vs ", reference_condition, ")"), x = "Difference", y = "-log10(FDR-adjusted p-value)")
    export_plot(plot_path(cell_type, paste0("differential_", modality, "_volcano")), volcano, width = 6, height = 5)

    prox_mat <- summary_proximity_data |>
      filter(group == cell_type, marker_1 == marker_2, marker_1 %in% labels$marker) |>
      select(marker = marker_1, sample_alias, mean_log2_ratio) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = sample_alias, values_from = mean_log2_ratio) |>
      column_to_rownames("marker") |>
      as.matrix()
    prox_mat <- t(scale(t(prox_mat[labels$marker, , drop = FALSE])))
    sample_hm <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
      prox_mat,
      color = PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
      name = "log2_ratio z-score",
      main = paste0(cell_type, " (", target, " vs ", reference_condition, ")")
    ) |>
      as.ggplot()
    export_plot(plot_path(cell_type, "sample_heatmap"), sample_hm, width = 6, height = 5)
  })

  # Effect-size heatmap of significant markers across cell types
  heatmap_mat <- plot_data |>
    filter(p_adj < dclust_plot_p_adj_threshold, abs(diff_median) > dclust_heatmap_effect_threshold) |>
    select(marker, group, diff_median) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = diff_median, values_fill = 0) |>
    column_to_rownames("marker") |>
    as.matrix()
  heatmap_plot <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_mat,
    color = PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
    main = paste0(target, " vs ", reference_condition)
  ) |>
    as.ggplot()
  export_plot(plot_path("effect_size_heatmap_all_celltypes"), heatmap_plot, width = 6, height = 6)
}
```

## 5.3. Differential colocalization analysis

Off-diagonal pairs (`marker_1 != marker_2`) from the same sample-level table as §5.2, then limma. `diff_median` again stores the limma logFC so module 07 can read this table the same way it reads the cell-level colocalization results. Set `stats_method` to `"pseudobulk"` to use these results (and the matching abundance tables) for enrichment.

```{r}
#| label: module05b_colocalization

# Limma cannot estimate a condition effect from a single sample, so skip the
# fit (without aborting the render) when a condition has fewer than two samples.
n_per_condition <- pg_data[[]] |>
  distinct(.data$sample_alias, .data[[contrast_column]]) |>
  count(.data[[contrast_column]]) |>
  pull(n)
if (length(n_per_condition) == 0 || any(n_per_condition < 2)) {
  warning("Skipping pseudobulk colocalization: need ≥2 sample_alias per condition.", call. = FALSE)
} else {
  # Covariates besides the contrast column itself and sample_alias.
  covariate_cols <- setdiff(as.character(pseudobulk_covariate_cols), c(contrast_column, "sample_alias"))

  differential_colocalization_analysis_pseudobulk <-
    (
      if (nrow(summary_proximity_data) > 0) {
        names(markers_to_test) |>
          map(function(cell_type) {
            tryCatch(
              {
                agg <- summary_proximity_data |>
                  filter(group == cell_type, marker_1 != marker_2)

                # One row per sample.
                sample_info <- pg_data[[]] |>
                  as_tibble() |>
                  transmute(
                    sample_alias = as.character(.data$sample_alias),
                    !!contrast_column := as.character(.data[[contrast_column]])
                  ) |>
                  distinct() |>
                  filter(.data$sample_alias %in% unique(as.character(agg$sample_alias)))
                if (length(covariate_cols) > 0) {
                  sample_info <- sample_info |>
                    left_join(
                      metadata |>
                        transmute(sample_alias = as.character(.data$sample_alias), across(all_of(covariate_cols))) |>
                        distinct(sample_alias, .keep_all = TRUE),
                      by = "sample_alias"
                    ) |>
                    drop_na(all_of(covariate_cols))
                }
                sample_info <- sample_info |>
                  mutate(!!contrast_column := droplevels(relevel(factor(.data[[contrast_column]]), ref = reference_condition))) |>
                  arrange(.data$sample_alias)

                # Missing sample × pair combinations become 0 (no observed
                # proximity), not NA, so limma can still fit them.
                expr_mat <- agg |>
                  mutate(sample_alias = as.character(sample_alias)) |>
                  filter(.data$sample_alias %in% sample_info$sample_alias) |>
                  select(feature, sample_alias, mean_log2_ratio) |>
                  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_alias, values_from = mean_log2_ratio, values_fill = 0, values_fn = mean) |>
                  column_to_rownames("feature") |>
                  as.matrix()
                expr_mat <- expr_mat[, sample_info$sample_alias, drop = FALSE]

                rhs <- if (length(covariate_cols) > 0) {
                  paste("~", contrast_column, "+", paste(covariate_cols, collapse = " + "))
                } else {
                  paste("~", contrast_column)
                }
                design <- model.matrix(stats::as.formula(rhs), data = sample_info)
                fit <- eBayes(lmFit(expr_mat, design), trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

                # adj.P.Val is BH within this fit (one cell type, one contrast).
                map_dfr(setdiff(levels(sample_info[[contrast_column]]), reference_condition), function(target) {
                  topTable(fit, coef = paste0(contrast_column, target), number = Inf, sort.by = "none", adjust.method = "BH") |>
                    as_tibble(rownames = "feature") |>
                    transmute(
                      feature,
                      diff_median = .data$logFC,
                      p = .data$P.Value,
                      p_adj = .data$adj.P.Val,
                      target = target,
                      reference = reference_condition,
                      method = "limma_pseudobulk"
                    )
                }) |>
                  left_join(distinct(agg, feature, marker_1, marker_2), by = "feature") |>
                  transmute(marker_1, marker_2, diff_median, p, p_adj, target, reference, method, group = cell_type)
              },
              error = function(e) {
                message(paste("Pseudobulk coloc error for", cell_type, ":", e$message))
                NULL
              }
            )
          }) |>
          bind_rows()
      } else {
        tibble()
      }
    )

  colocalization_dir <- here::here("results", "05_statistical_testing", "colocalization", "pseudobulk")
  dir.create(colocalization_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write_rds(differential_colocalization_analysis_pseudobulk, file.path(colocalization_dir, "differential_colocalization_analysis.rds"))
  write_csv(differential_colocalization_analysis_pseudobulk, file.path(colocalization_dir, "differential_colocalization_analysis.csv"))
}
```

### 5.3.1. Summarizing plots

Here we create summarizing plots for the differential colocalization analysis results, with the same layout as §5.1.1. Each row is a marker pair (`marker_1_marker_2`):

1. **Per-cell-type volcano + sample heatmap**: Volcano of `diff_median` vs −log10 adjusted p-value, top `dcoloc_volcano_top_n` pairs labeled by **adjusted significance**, beside a row-z-scored heatmap of sample-mean pair `log2_ratio` (`summary_proximity_data`). Saved in the cell type's own folder.

2. **Effect-size heatmap**: Pairs with `p_adj < dcoloc_plot_p_adj_threshold` and `|diff_median| > dcoloc_heatmap_effect_threshold` across cell types.

```{r}
#| label: module05b_colocalization_plots

if (
  exists("differential_colocalization_analysis_pseudobulk") &&
    nrow(differential_colocalization_analysis_pseudobulk) > 0
) {
  modality <- "colocalization"
  target <- setdiff(unique(differential_colocalization_analysis_pseudobulk$target), reference_condition)[1]

  # results/05_statistical_testing/{modality}/pseudobulk/{target}_vs_{reference}/...
  plot_path <- function(...) {
    here::here(
      "results/05_statistical_testing", modality, "pseudobulk",
      paste0(target, "_vs_", reference_condition),
      ...
    )
  }

  # Cross-marker pairs. "A_B" matches summary_proximity_data$feature.
  plot_data <- differential_colocalization_analysis_pseudobulk |>
    filter(target == !!target) |>
    mutate(
      marker = paste(marker_1, marker_2, sep = "_"),
      neg_log10_p_adj = -log10(pmax(p_adj, min_p_value_threshold))
    )

  # Per cell type: volcano with its n most significant labeled pairs, plus a
  # row-z-scored sample heatmap of those pairs' log2_ratio. Both saved under
  # the cell type's own folder within the target-vs-reference folder.
  walk(unique(plot_data$group), function(cell_type) {
    data <- filter(plot_data, group == cell_type)
    labels <- slice_max(data, order_by = neg_log10_p_adj, n = dcoloc_volcano_top_n, with_ties = FALSE)

    volcano <- ggplot(data, aes(diff_median, neg_log10_p_adj, color = diff_median)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.7) +
      geom_text(data = labels, aes(label = marker), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
      scale_color_gradient2() +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(title = paste0(cell_type, " (", target, " vs ", reference_condition, ")"), x = "Difference", y = "-log10(FDR-adjusted p-value)")
    export_plot(plot_path(cell_type, paste0("differential_", modality, "_volcano")), volcano, width = 6, height = 5)

    prox_mat <- summary_proximity_data |>
      filter(group == cell_type, feature %in% labels$marker) |>
      select(marker = feature, sample_alias, mean_log2_ratio) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = sample_alias, values_from = mean_log2_ratio) |>
      column_to_rownames("marker") |>
      as.matrix()
    prox_mat <- t(scale(t(prox_mat[labels$marker, , drop = FALSE])))
    sample_hm <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
      prox_mat,
      color = PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
      name = "log2_ratio z-score",
      main = paste0(cell_type, " (", target, " vs ", reference_condition, ")")
    ) |>
      as.ggplot()
    export_plot(plot_path(cell_type, "sample_heatmap"), sample_hm, width = 6, height = 5)

    # Dot heatmap of diff_median for this cell type's significant pairs, dot
    # size = -log10(p_adj). ColocalizationHeatmap errors with fewer than two
    # significant pairs, so skip a cell type that has 0 or 1 instead of aborting.
    sig_pairs <- data |>
      filter(p_adj < dcoloc_plot_p_adj_threshold) |>
      arrange(desc(neg_log10_p_adj))
    if (nrow(sig_pairs) < 2) {
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    coloc_hm <- ColocalizationHeatmap(
      sig_pairs,
      marker1_col = "marker_1",
      marker2_col = "marker_2",
      value_col = "diff_median",
      type = "dots",
      colors = gradient_palette,
      size_col_transform = \(x) -log10(x)
    ) &
      labs(
        size = "-log10(p_adj)",
        fill = "Difference\nin medians",
        title = paste0(cell_type, " (", target, " vs ", reference_condition, ")")
      ) &
      scale_size(range = c(1, 5), limits = c(0, max(-log10(sig_pairs$p_adj))))
    plot_markers <- unique(c(sig_pairs$marker_1, sig_pairs$marker_2))
    export_plot(
      plot_path(cell_type, "colocalization_heatmap"),
      coloc_hm,
      width = max(4, length(plot_markers) * 0.15 + 1.5),
      height = max(4, length(plot_markers) * 0.15 + 3)
    )
  })

  # Effect-size heatmap of significant pairs across cell types
  heatmap_mat <- plot_data |>
    filter(p_adj < dcoloc_plot_p_adj_threshold, abs(diff_median) > dcoloc_heatmap_effect_threshold) |>
    select(marker, group, diff_median) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = diff_median, values_fill = 0) |>
    column_to_rownames("marker") |>
    as.matrix()
  heatmap_plot <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_mat,
    color = PixelgenGradient(100, "BluesCherry"),
    main = paste0(target, " vs ", reference_condition)
  ) |>
    as.ggplot()
  export_plot(plot_path("effect_size_heatmap_all_celltypes"), heatmap_plot, width = 6, height = 6)
}
```
